g.text: Where the token work goes now the prefix cache works
Last 40 minutes of real agent traffic, 1,067 requests averaging 115,000 prompt tokens each. Bars are drawn on the work actually done.
97.7% of prompt tokens — already resident, nothing recomputed
Before the router repair this bar was 8.4% and the one below it was 91.6%. That inversion is why the purchase case had to be re-argued.
A seventh of the 16,384-token chunked-prefill budget, so that setting is not binding and tuning it buys nothing.
One forward pass per token. This is the phase that costs wall clock, the phase a decode benchmark measures, and the
only one speculative decoding can shorten. Every hardware argument in this study is ultimately about this bar.
